evidence: Walked instruction.md and hireops_rules.md line by line against solution/app. Every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation: (1) Sign-in for all 10 brief accounts with Hireops!2026 (db.js:63-66, index.js:84-101; seed emails match instruction.md:17). (2) Staff views Board, Conversations, Activity and candidate 'My applications' view (app.js:87-91, threads.js:27,223). (3) Board: six stages incl. Rejected (board.js:27-31); one-stage moves via a per-card select+Move button, reject with required reason, reopen only to rejected_from (board.js:144-158,226-232; index.js:238-264); optional drag (board.js:242,300-319); Up/Down shared ordering persisted in SQLite positions (board.js:233-241; index.js:199-200,296-317); Interview places shown in header and enforced (board.js:327; index.js:289-294). (4) Refused move: optimistic local move, snapshot restored, reason shown, focus returned to the card controls (board.js:181-205); stale version -> 409 naming who via the card's last activity line (index.js:241-245). (5) Bulk all-or-nothing in board order with Interview counted for the set (board.js:277-290; index.js:273-320,327-331). (6) Undo own last move single/bulk, restores stage, place and removed reason, refused if any card changed or Interview would overfill, single-use, superseded by later move (board.js:291-299,367-368; index.js:165-168,335-360). (7) Live updates via SSE 'changed' events -> debounced refresh, patched in place keeping open card, note draft and focus (app.js:130-164; board.js:321-341,350-371; index.js:45-54,102-107). (8) Internal notes with per-person per-browser unsaved note draft (board.js:86-141). (9) Recruiter forms: open a job (title, team, hiring manager from HM accounts, 1-50 places) and add a candidate with email validation/duplicate-per-job shown at the field keeping typed values, candidate-account linkage (board.js:40-83; index.js:202-233). (10) Activity: readable lines with actor/stages, rejection reason, newest first, all-jobs or one-job filter, append-only, refused actions add none via transactions (app.js:45-85; index.js:189,195-198,265-270). (11) Conversations: latest 30 oldest-first scrolled to newest, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count and scroll anchoring, Enter sends/Shift+Enter newline, box cleared and focused after send, failure keeps text, arrival while scrolled up leaves place and shows 'N new messages', per-person unread and total badge, 'Seen'/'Sent' receipt on my last message with observer excluded, per-person per-conversation drafts surviving switch/reload/sign-out, other users see none (threads.js:68-201,222; app.js:38-43,187-195; index.js:132-162,376-409). (12) Role/access rules incl. 401/403/candidate 404 and candidate read model with candidate wording only (index.js:68-81,114-131,169-177). (13) Runtime contract: node /app/server.js, PORT, /api/health answered before DB work in a separate thread, DB_PATH, seeding once from a bundled copy resolved by __dirname, no shipped DB (bootstrap.js:8-58; db.js:9-10,61-62; solve.sh). Runtime corroboration (scripted golden, not a judge run): results/workspace.json records 18 groups all passed:true on the frozen bytes (hashes verified), covering transitions, interview places, stale-version naming who, roles, undo, bulk, candidate privacy and paging, unread/seen, board UI flows, live arrival (arrival_ms 806), conversation paging/arrival, drafts, session loss, observer read-only incl. Activity, restart persistence, no page errors. The Activity one-job filter is present in source (app.js:47,58-65,82) but not exercised in that script. One reference-fidelity deviation found (not a missing deliverable): a hiring manager can re-order a card inside the Rejected column when it was rejected from Interview/Offer. index.js:259-262 sets origin=rejected_from and target=origin when toStage==='REJECTED', so a same-stage REJECTED->REJECTED reorder passes the MANAGER_STAGES test, and board.js:159-162 mayReorder offers Up/Down for it; hireops_rules.md:70-72 limits managers to Interview/Offer/Hired 'including re-ordering cards in those stages ... Everything else is refused for them.' functional/judge.toml hro_mgr_late_stages (146) and hro_mgr_early_refused (155) do not probe this, so it does not affect grading, but it is an unresolved over-permission in the reference. Risk is true because of that unresolved deviation and because no configured judge/Oracle run is available; no Oracle, model or portal score is claimed.
counterexample: Not a row-17 coverage counterexample (no asked-for capability is missing). Fidelity deviation for the owner: sign in as the job's own hiring manager, reject two Interview cards with reasons, then press 'Move <name> up' on the lower card in Rejected; the reference accepts it and logs '<HM> reordered <name> in Rejected', whereas hireops_rules.md:70-72 says that is refused for a hiring manager. Tried a plausible broken app that could pass this row: an app with Board/Conversations/Activity but no per-job Activity filter would still be caught by the functional criterion at judge.toml:263; the reference does implement the filter. Conforming alternative that could fail: none found for this row, since the brief leaves names/layout open and the reference does not impose them.
suggested_fix: Optional P3 fidelity fix: in index.js checkMove refuse a hiring manager's same-stage move when from==='REJECTED' (and hide Up/Down for Rejected cards in board.js mayReorder for managers), then rerun the scripted golden.
